mapper.select: SELECT benefit_id, card_type, store_name, latitude, longitude, description, discount_type, discount_rate, discount_price, point_amount FROM benefits WHERE card_type = #{cardType}
SELECT benefit_id, card_type, store_name, latitude, longitude, description, discount_type, discount_rate, discount_price, point_amount FROM benefits ORDER BY card_type, benefit_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefits ( benefit_id, card_type, store_name, latitude, longitude, description, discount_type, discount_rate, discount_price, point_amount ) VALUES ( SUBSTR(#{cardType}, 1, 3) || LPAD(NVL((SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(benefit_id, 4))) FROM benefits WHERE SUBSTR(benefit_id, 1, 3) = SUBSTR(#{cardType}, 1, 3)), 0) + 1, 4, '0'), #{cardType}, #{storeName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{discountType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{discountRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{discountPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{pointAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, store_name, product_name, price, description FROM products WHERE store_name = #{storeName} ORDER BY product_id
